what: The public change log of /omega/: one dated entry per change of the page or of its state. The builder refuses when the newest entry’s state is not the records’.

entries.what: The page opens, public and listed. The pre-registration was sealed at 02:52 UTC on 25 November, before any run: twenty rows in three phases, the verdict rule and seven gaps read at the pin. Phase 1 runs on a rented machine; the pin step is under way. Both blind statements are written and sealed before elaboration: writer B (GPT-6.2-astra) at about 03:03 UTC, writer A (a Claude agent) at 03:06 UTC. The statement reader, the two readings of the lower-bound proof and the provenance scout are at work.

entries.what: VERDICT: CERTIFIED under the sealed rule. Both blind statements are proved from the release's theorems and Comparator accepts each with Lean's kernel and nanoda, con-leche agreeing (F2); the nine anchors hold (F3); every item of the statement reader is decided (F4, A12). What it does not say: that any human checked the mathematics; the per-size gate count in nonscalar gates, geometric border rank, or Corollary 1.3 (absent from the release); divisions beyond the square case. Sun's conflicting construction: NEEDS DATA, twice (X1).

entries.what: Phase 4, after the verdict and outside it (amendment A13; the verdict is unchanged): the corollaries the release does not state (gap G3), stated by a Claude agent without seeing the release's Lean and sealed before elaboration (A14), are proved from the release's theorems. G3a (the per-n bound counting every multiplication and division gate), G3b (the paper's per-n bound in nonscalar gates, ⌈n^{9/4}/2⌉ at every n ≥ 2), G3c (the asymptotic rank of T_n equals n^{9/4}) and G3d (the geometric border rank of T_n is at least n^{9/4}) passed: Comparator with our statement file as the challenge accepts under Lean's kernel and nanoda, con-leche justifies all four, and a planted copy with one constant changed is refused by both. G3-CR passed: a fresh machine that never ran the release's code accepts the transferred export. Both exported proofs are published as release assets; the two Phase 4 machines are counted in the money.
